prior_outcomes_seen: V0 all nine clock-only and mean-gain results; no pretense of blind rediscovery
population_truth: Same stationary solar-phase intensity and full operation in all 41 original paired dates and 82 simulated stations
counterfactual: Remove branch-specific astronomy by projecting BOTH rising and falling event phase into the ascending date's phase-to-civil mapping for that exact original pair; keep identical event counts, phase, station, pair, branch and RNG streams.
reference: Actual uses true 2022 ascending/descending phase-to-clock mapping for each matched pair; solar uses original phase bins. Placebo clock uses ascending mapping for both dates.
predefined_model: Reuse frozen v0 fit_conditional_branch_model six-bin conditional method lambda=2, fixed train40/heldout42 site split and full 41x6 heldout denominator
metric: clock-only selection using positive heldout site-equal gain with solar <=0; compare actual geometry and placebo geometry on same events, per-world paired difference, NOT calibrated significance
actual_v0_replay: All nine actual clock-only selection frequencies and gains must reproduce frozen PR235 receipt to numerical floating tolerance, without post-outcome refitting/retuning
primary_effect: Mean per-world paired difference I(actual_clock>0 AND solar<=0) - I(placebo_clock>0 AND solar<=0), reported across all nine profiles and event counts
secondary: actual and placebo clock-only selection frequencies
actual and placebo clock-any selection frequencies
mean actual and placebo heldout score gain
Monte Carlo paired difference SE=sd(per-world difference,ddof=1)/sqrt(200)
frozen_expectations: under fixed geometry-neutral law, solar-phase distribution invariant by construction
actual selection may or may not exceed placebo
zero or negative excess must be reported unchanged
no crossing confidence threshold is predeclared
no sorting or winner selection of nine conditions
guardrails: no animal or camera-operator source rows
